context: A chef and barista plan an event
purpose: Teach: はがき/盛大/綱/分厚い/先人/新郎/新婦/狐

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、はがきDM、新規客に出そか。
lines.en: Aoi-san, should we send postcards to new customers?
lines.style: Easy, energetic Kansai accent. Warmth beneath the bluntness. Leaning forward with genuine interest. Not asking permission — inviting collaboration.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。創業記念、盛大に祝う、企画ですね。
lines.en: Yes. It's part of our founding anniversary celebration plan.
lines.style: Quiet assent. Gentle nod in her voice. Present but not dominant. The way she says yes before the fuller thought — already imagining it working.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 体験イベントで、綱引き大会も、面白いな。
lines.en: And a tug-of-war tournament at the experience event could be really fun.
lines.style: Eyes lighting up slightly in the tone. Casual confidence — he's already picturing it. Kansai warmth underneath. The pleased certainty of someone who knows a good idea when he hears one.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メニュー帳、分厚い記念版、出しましょう。
lines.en: We should put out a thick commemorative edition of the menu.
lines.style: Sudden brightness — a spark of her own idea catching. Energized, not loud. Forward momentum. The voice of someone contributing something she's already thought through.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 先人のレシピ、店で復活、ええなあ。
lines.en: And bringing back the old family recipes in the shop — that's real nice.
lines.style: Slowing slightly, softer tone. Appreciating the weight of it. Kansai accent gentle here. Respectful pause on the sentiment. Speaking to the heart of what this means.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 結婚式コラボ、新郎向けのコース、開発します。
lines.en: We can develop a special course for grooms as part of a wedding collaboration.
lines.style: Bright, capable energy. Forward-moving. Clear voice, no hesitation. The enthusiasm of someone already seeing the future. Warmth without trying.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 新婦向けには、エレガントなスイーツ、用意しよ。
lines.en: And for brides, we'll prepare something elegant and refined in the sweets.
lines.style: Thoughtful, balancing tone. Kansai accent grounded and reflective. Considering both options equally. The voice of someone thinking through details with care.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お稲荷さん由来、狐モチーフのグッズ、店頭で販売します。
lines.en: We'll sell fox-motif goods inspired by Inari at the counter.
lines.style: Warm close. The final note is satisfied, complete. Gentle pride in the details. Voice settling into the rightness of it. A natural, earned closing warmth.
